module_summary: src/ui/guisettings.cpp is the Settings shell and all its pages, split out of gui.cpp: the SettingsShell class (page composition from several dialog templates into a scratch buffer, page result routing, Index hub, save prompt, and a source-state snapshot restored on 'Exit without saving'), the nine peer pages (Game Sources, General, Language, Network, Interface, Launch, PS Emulation/POPSTARTER, Controllers, Audio) and their chained sub-dialogs (MMCE, Artwork, Coverflow, Colors, VCD list, BDMA, POPSTARTER network/UDPFS editors, Neutrino args, Date and Time, Ember per-game settings, video-mode confirmation). It also owns the one Protocol picker shared by Game Sources and Network and the long-path keyboard handlers referenced from dialogs.cpp. include/guisplash.h declares the BootSplash class (boot logo/intro loop) implemented in src/ui/guisplash.cpp; nothing in it is unused.

reusable_helpers.name: guiCopyNameList / guiFreeNameList
reusable_helpers.what: deep-copies / frees a NULL-terminated string list (snapshot of a heap list owned by another thread)

reusable_helpers.name: SettingsShell::composeInto
reusable_helpers.what: concatenates several UIItem dialog templates into one page buffer, dropping per-template OK rows and redundant headers

reusable_helpers.name: guiReadPopsNet
reusable_helpers.what: queues a job on the IO worker and pumps real frames with cancel and timeout until it finishes

reusable_helpers.name: guiClockDaysIn / guiClockShift
reusable_helpers.what: days-in-month for 2000-2099 and minute shift of a {y,m,d,h,min} date across day/month/year borders

reusable_helpers.name: guiClockWrite
reusable_helpers.what: writes the PS2 RTC via sceCdWriteClock with one retry

reusable_helpers.name: guiDiscListItem
reusable_helpers.what: fills one UIItem for a dialog built at runtime

reusable_helpers.name: guiDrawBGSettings
reusable_helpers.what: draws the theme's settings background texture, returns 0 when there is none

reusable_helpers.name: NEUTRINO_ARG_HANDLER
reusable_helpers.what: macro defining a UI_STRING keyboard handler that edits a full-size backing buffer

findings.title: Legacy sub-page buttons (VCD_BDMA, MMCE_COMM, MMCE_PATH, LAUNCH_NEUTRINO_DEFAULTS) never render; composeInto's skip logic exists only to hide them
findings.problem: diaVcdConfig, diaMmceConfig and diaLaunchConfig are only ever used as compose parts (guisettings.cpp:359, 2798, 2903), and every compose call skips exactly these four button ids, so the rows plus their label/spacer/break lines never render; the comments calling them 'callable outside the Settings shell' are false. guiSettingsSkipID and the orphaned-label removal at 2085-2099 serve only these rows, skipPart is -1 at all 7 calls, and suppressSecondaryHeaders is 0 only on a 1-part page where it has no effect.
findings.fix: Delete the four button rows (with their label/spacer/break lines and comments) from the templates, the four enum ids, the three skipIDs arrays, guiSettingsSkipID and the skip block in composeInto, and drop the skipIDs/skipCount/skipPart/suppressSecondaryHeaders parameters from compose/composeInto (always suppress). Optionally drop the HINT_BDMA_BUTTON, HINT_MMCE_COMM_BUTTON, HINT_MMCE_PATH_BUTTON and HINT_NEUTRINO_DEFAULTS_BUTTON strings from _base.yml and the lng/fork translations.
findings.benefit: ~65 code lines (dialogs.cpp 18, dialogs.h 4, guisettings.cpp ~35, _base.yml 8) plus ~130 translation lines; ~270 bytes of English hint text and 4 table rows in the ELF (INFERRED from string lengths).
findings.evidence: Grep (excl. docs/.github) for MMCE_COMM_BUTTON|MMCE_PATH_BUTTON|VCD_BDMA_BUTTON|LAUNCH_NEUTRINO_DEFAULTS_BUTTON: only dialogs.h enum, dialogs.cpp rows 658/838/842/1233 and the skipIDs at guisettings.cpp 360/2799/2904. diaVcdConfig/diaLaunchConfig/diaMmceConfig: only extern in dialogs.h, definition, and compose parts in guisettings.cpp. _STR_HINT_BDMA_BUTTON/_STR_HINT_NEUTRINO_DEFAULTS_BUTTON/_STR_HINT_MMCE_*_BUTTON used only by those rows. _STR_BDMA_SETTINGS/_COMM_SETTINGS/_PATH_SETTINGS stay (headers at dialogs.cpp 679/857/929). All compose/composeInto calls read: skipPart -1 everywhere.

findings.title: SettingsShell::shellActive_ guards are constant: every page runs inside the shell, no standalone callers remain
findings.problem: shellActive_ is true for the whole of showFromPage, and every reader runs only from there: guiShowMmceConfig (static, sole caller 2517), guiShowVcdListConfig (static, sole caller 2952) and beginDialog (called only by the nine pages dispatched at 3274-3301). So the '!shellActive()' legacy apply at 401-406 never runs, the 'if (shellActive())' at 1253 is always true, and beginDialog's early return never fires.
findings.fix: Delete the dead branch at 401-406, make 1253-1254 an unconditional markSavePending(), drop the guard in beginDialog, then delete shellActive_, shellActive() and the five assignments in showFromPage, and the 'legacy standalone callers' header comment.
findings.benefit: ~20 lines removed; a bool field and a few branches (INFERRED, tens of bytes).
findings.evidence: Grep shellActive|beginDialog over src include (excl docs/.github): readers only at guisettings.cpp 403, 1253, 2212; writers only in showFromPage 3262-3322. Callers: guiShowMmceConfig only at 2517 (guiSettingsShowSources); guiShowVcdListConfig only at 2952 (guiSettingsShowPopstarter); beginDialog at 942, 1982, 2008, 2385, 2438, 2510, 2680, 2828, 2942, all inside page functions whose only callers are the showFromPage switch (guiShowNetConfig: gui.h prototype, only caller 3285).

findings.title: guiShowNetConfig pre-seeds enabled/visible states that netConfigUpdater(1) overwrites before the first frame
findings.problem: guiShowNetConfig calls netConfigUpdater(1) at 928 before diaExecuteDialog, and the updater recomputes every one of these: ETHOPMODE/SHARE_PORT enabled (730-731), SHARE_NB_ADDR visible (712), the PS2 IP/mask/gateway/DNS enabled and share-IP visible loops (719-728), UDPFSMODE and SMBDIALECT enabled (755-765). The comment at 920-921 ('renders the FIRST frame before it calls netConfigUpdater') is stale for that reason. Line 860 is diaSetInt on a UI_STRING row, which diaSetInt ignores (diaitems.cpp:104). Inside the updater, 696 is overwritten by 712.
findings.fix: Delete the listed setEnabled/setVisible lines (keep the diaSetInt value seeding in the loops), the no-op diaSetInt at 860, the stale comment, and line 696.
findings.benefit: ~17 lines removed and a few dozen redundant dialog lookups per page open (INFERRED).
findings.evidence: Read guisettings.cpp 636-769 (netConfigUpdater, all under if(modified)) and 823-945; the explicit netConfigUpdater(1) is at 928, after every listed line and before diaExecuteDialog at 945. dialogs.cpp:151 shows NETCFG_SHARE_NB_ADDR is UI_STRING; diaitems.cpp:97-111 shows diaSetInt only acts on UI_INT/BOOL/ENUM. For the RiptOPLite cases the updater's netProto default (647-653) yields the same SMBDIALECT enable as line 923.

findings.title: Four long-path keyboard handlers repeat the body of NEUTRINO_ARG_HANDLER
findings.problem: guiExitPathHandler, guiNfsExportHandler, guiNeutrinoPathHandler and guiPopstarterPathHandler are each the same 7 lines (guiShowKeyboard on a backing buffer, snprintf into text) that the NEUTRINO_ARG_HANDLER macro already generates for the 7 Neutrino-args handlers; they differ only in function name and buffer.
findings.fix: Generalise the macro to take the function name and the buffer expression, define all 11 handlers with it, and delete the four hand-written copies.
findings.benefit: ~22 lines removed (4 x 7 lines -> 4 macro lines, minus small macro change); no ELF change (same code) (INFERRED).
findings.evidence: Read all four functions and the macro; the handlers are referenced only as function pointers in dialogs.cpp rows 186, 468, 621, 1257 and prototyped in gui.h:144-147, so the names must stay, which the macro keeps.

findings.title: guiSetBdmaSettings / guiBdmaUpdater: forwarding wrapper, dead fallback, duplicated visibility block, stale comment
findings.problem: guiSettingsPopstarterUpdater only forwards to guiBdmaUpdater, its sole caller. guiBdmaUpdater falls back to diaBdmaConfig when activeDialog() is NULL, but it only runs during the POPSTARTER page after compose() set activeDialog_ (2911, 2136). guiSetBdmaSettings repeats the updater's four setVisible lines. The page comment names a non-existent guiShowBdmaConfig and calls BDMA a chained sub-dialog, but it is composed inline.
findings.fix: Pass guiBdmaUpdater straight to diaExecuteDialog at 2945 and delete the wrapper. Use activeDialog() without the fallback. Replace 1198-1201 with a guiBdmaUpdater(1) call. Correct the comment to name only the two real sub-dialogs.
findings.evidence: Grep guiBdmaUpdater|guiSettingsPopstarterUpdater|guiShowBdmaConfig over the repo (excl docs/.github): guiBdmaUpdater defined 1101, called only at 2870; wrapper used only at 2945; guiShowBdmaConfig appears only in the comment at 2899. guiSetBdmaSettings is called only at 2941, after compose at 2911 made activeDialog the page ui.

findings.title: 'if (guiDrawBGSettings() == 0) guiDrawBGPlasma();' repeated at all 10 call sites
findings.problem: Every caller of guiDrawBGSettings uses its return value only to draw the plasma when there is no settings background, so the fallback is written out ten times.
findings.fix: Have guiDrawBGSettings call guiDrawBGPlasma itself when the theme has no SETTINGS_BG texture and return void; replace each two-line call site with one call.
findings.benefit: ~10 lines removed and ten compare/branch sequences (INFERRED, well under 100 bytes).
findings.evidence: Grep 'guiDrawBGSettings\(\)' -A1 over src: 10 calls, each followed by guiDrawBGPlasma(); prototype gui.h:143; no other use of the return value.

findings.title: Source re-apply cascade written twice (Game Sources apply and restoreSourceState)
findings.problem: Both places run the same sequence: request a PCCF probe if gEnablePCCF changed, then bdmForceDeviceRefresh, applyConfig(-1,-1,0), menuReinitMainMenu, and the All Games / Show Hidden / loadFavourites chain. That is about 11 identical lines given the previous allGames, showHidden and PCCF values.
findings.fix: Move the sequence into one static helper taking the three previous values and call it from both places.
findings.benefit: ~7 lines net removed; one copy of the logic to keep in step (INFERRED).
findings.evidence: Read both blocks line by line: 2549-2557 and 3092-3100 are token-identical; the PCCF probe condition at 2541-2544 and 3065/3090-3091 is the same test on saved vs new gEnablePCCF.

findings.title: Five functions exported through headers but used only inside guisettings.cpp
findings.problem: guiShowColorsConfig, guiShowNetConfig, guiShowPopsNetConfig, guiCopyNameList and guiFreeNameList have no caller outside guisettings.cpp; the header prototypes are left over from before the split out of gui.cpp.
findings.fix: Make the five functions static and delete their five prototypes from gui.h and guiint.h.
findings.benefit: 5 header lines removed; lets the compiler inline single-use code (no measurable ELF change; --gc-sections already used per BUILD-EVIDENCE.md:146) (INFERRED).
findings.evidence: Grep over the repo (excl docs/.github): guiShowColorsConfig called only at guisettings.cpp:2692; guiShowNetConfig only at 3285; guiShowPopsNetConfig only at 2947; guiCopyNameList only at 2430/2636; guiFreeNameList only at 2457/2778. Other matches are comments (themes.cpp, dialogs.cpp) and .github test scripts that search for the substring 'int guiShowNetConfig(', which 'static int guiShowNetConfig(' still contains (INFERRED for the tests).

findings.title: No-op statements in guisettings.cpp: write-only guiPopsNetReadPending, re-enabling rows that are already enabled/visible
findings.problem: guiPopsNetReadPending is assigned in four places and never read (guiPopsNetReadInFlight is what gets tested). The diaSetEnabled(...,1) calls for CFG_ENABLEBDMHDD, CFG_HDDMODE and CFG_MMCEMODE, and diaSetVisible(UICFG_COVERFLOW_BUTTON,1), act on a freshly composed copy whose templates already have enabled=1, visible=1 (dialogs.cpp 510, 515, 539, 1021), and nothing in the repo ever disables or hides those ids.
findings.fix: Delete guiPopsNetReadPending and its assignments, and the four no-op diaSetEnabled/diaSetVisible calls with the comment above the last one.
findings.evidence: Grep guiPopsNetReadPending over the repo: only 1322, 1344, 1363, 1367 (all writes). Grep diaSetEnabled/diaSetVisible on CFG_ENABLEBDMHDD|CFG_HDDMODE|CFG_MMCEMODE|UICFG_COVERFLOW_BUTTON over src: only these four lines; the dialogs.cpp rows show enabled and visible fields = 1; composeInto copies rows from the templates at every page entry (2130).

findings.title: Header clutter in guisettings.cpp: duplicate sound.h include, four unneeded forward declarations with a copy-pasted comment, stray comment
findings.problem: include/sound.h is included at 33 and again at 49. guiShowVcdListConfig, guiShowCoverflowConfig, guiShowArtworkConfig and guiShowMmceConfig are all defined (1241, 1881, 1776, 357) before their only uses (2952, 2688, 2684, 2517), so their forward declarations and the four copies of 'was declared in the header before it became file-local' serve no purpose. Only guiConfirmVideoMode (defined 3412, used 2769) needs one. '// Last Played Auto Start' above <time.h> is unrelated to that include, which is there for clock().
findings.fix: Delete line 49, the comment at 59, and lines 68-78. Keep the guiConfirmVideoMode declaration at 66, without its comment.
findings.evidence: Read lines 1-78 and checked definition and use lines with Grep in guisettings.cpp; clock() is used at 1350, 1372, 1388, 3422-3473.
